∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ}
  (V : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T P : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  (∀ (k : ℕ), Matrix.det (P k) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ), P (k + 1) = P k * T k) →
      (∀ (k : ℕ), V (k + 1) = V k * T k + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) (b k)) →
        ∀ (m K L C : ℝ),
          0 < m →
            0 < K →
              0 ≤ L →
                (∀ (k : ℕ), m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V k).transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) →
                  (∀ (k : ℕ),
                      BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V (k + 1)).transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) / R.curvature k ≤ C) →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℝ),
                        BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((Matrix.transpose (P k)).mulVec v) ≤ K * BfgsVerification.sqNorm v) →
                      (∀ (k : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℝ),

                        ∀ (G : ℝ),
                          0 < G →
                            (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →
                              Filter.Tendsto R.d Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → False

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ} (k : ℕ)

          T +
        (R.curvature k)⁻¹ •
          BfgsVerification.outer (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k))

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r p : ℕ} (k : ℕ)
  (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ),
  U.transpose * U = 1 →
    ∀ (L : ℝ),
      (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (U.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) ≤ L * R.curvature k) →
        ∀ (V W Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : BfgsVerification.Mat p) (b : BfgsVerification.Vec p)
          (m C₀ C_T C_R : ℝ),
          0 ≤ C_T →
            m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k)) →
              BfgsVerification.sqNorm (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) ≤ C₀ * R.curvature k →
                W = V * T + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) b + Z →
                  BfgsVerification.FrameBounds.OperatorSqBound T (1 + C_T * R.d k) →
                    U * U.transpose * Z = Z →
                      BfgsVerification.SmoothSubspace.frobSq Z ≤ C_R * R.d k →
                        (BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian (k + 1)) W).trace ≤
                          (1 + R.d k) * (1 + C_T * R.d k) *
                                ((BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian k) V).trace - m / R.q k) +
                              (1 + (R.d k)⁻¹) *
                                (C_R * R.d k * ((BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian 0) U).trace + L * ↑k)) +
                            C₀

    (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.sqNorm (R.g k) ≤ G ^ 2) →

        ∀ (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ),
          U.transpose * U = 1 →
            ∀ (L m C₀ C_T C_R : ℝ),

                      0 ≤ C_R →
                        (∀ (k : ℕ),

                          ∀ (V Z : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin p) ℝ) (T : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Mat p)
                            (b : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec p),
                            (∀ (k : ℕ), m ≤ BfgsVerification.sqNorm ((V k).transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) →

                                    (∀ (k : ℕ), U * U.transpose * Z k = Z k) →
                                      (∀ (k : ℕ), BfgsVerification.SmoothSubspace.frobSq (Z k) ≤ C_R * R.d k) → False

    ∀ (b : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ),
      BfgsVerification.AffineCertificate.objective A⁻¹ (-Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ b)
          (BfgsVerification.AffineCertificate.objective A b F) =
        F

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  ∀ z ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g),
    ‖z‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖ ^ 2 +
        ‖z - BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖ ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  ∀ z ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g),
    inner z (BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i) =
      ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖ ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (c : ℝ),
  (∀ (i : α), inner (g i) a = c) → ∀ z ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g), inner z a = c

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
  (∀ (i : α), inner (g i) v = -1) → 0 ∉ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g)

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  0 ∉ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g) →
    ∀ (j : α),
      inner (g j)
          (-(‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ •
            BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i) =
        -1

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i j : α),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i =
    BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g j

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g)

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i ∈
    (BfgsVerification.AccessibleJumpGeometry.jumpSpace g)ᗮ

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  ∀ z ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g),
    ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ∧
      (‖z‖ = ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖ ↔
        z = BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i)

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i = 0 ↔ 0 ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g)

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i =
    ↑((EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection (affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g))) 0)

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  ∀ a ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g),
    (∀ (j : α), inner (g j) a = ‖a‖ ^ 2) → a = BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
  α → ((∃ v, ∀ (j : α), inner (g j) v = -1) ↔ 0 ∉ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g))

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i j : α),
  g j - BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i ∈
    BfgsVerification.AccessibleJumpGeometry.jumpSpace g

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α),
  Metric.infDist 0 ↑(affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g)) = ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i‖

∀ {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (i : α) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
  z ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range g) ↔
    z - BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint g i ∈
      BfgsVerification.AccessibleJumpGeometry.jumpSpace g

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.AffineCorrectAt F x ↔
        x ∉ BfgsVerification.argmin F →
          ∃ v, ∀ g ∈ BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x, BfgsVerification.dot g v = -1

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ {x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.AffineCorrectAt F x

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (S : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)),
  BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x = (convexHull ℝ) S →
    affineSpan ℝ (Set.range (BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.subgradientFamily F x)) =
      affineSpan ℝ (BfgsVerification.euclideanVector '' S)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  Metric.infDist 0 ↑(affineSpan ℝ (Set.range (BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.subgradientFamily F x))) =
    ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.canonicalVector hF x‖

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n)
  (g : ↑(BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x)),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.canonicalVector hF x =
    BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalGeometry.closestAffinePoint
      (BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.subgradientFamily F x) g

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  g ∈ BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x →
    inner (BfgsVerification.euclideanVector g) (BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.canonicalVector hF x) =
      ‖BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.canonicalVector hF x‖ ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (hF : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.canonicalVector hF x = 0 ↔
    BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F x

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∃ v, ∀ g ∈ BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x, BfgsVerification.dot g v = -1) ↔
        ¬BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F x

∀ {n : ℕ} (g v : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  inner (BfgsVerification.euclideanVector g) (BfgsVerification.euclideanVector v) = BfgsVerification.dot g v

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.IsAffineCritical F x ↔
    0 ∈ affineSpan ℝ (BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x)

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  Set.range (BfgsVerification.AffineCriticalObjective.subgradientFamily F x) =
    BfgsVerification.euclideanVector '' BfgsVerification.ConvexSubdifferential.subdifferential F x

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n}, Matrix.PosDef H → Matrix.PosDef (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A H)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (u : BfgsVerification.Vec r) (v : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.dot (A.transpose.mulVec u) v = BfgsVerification.dot u (A.mulVec v)

∀ {n : ℕ} (B : BfgsVerification.Mat n),
  Matrix.IsSymm B →
    ∀ (u v : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      BfgsVerification.metricEnergy B (u + v) =
        BfgsVerification.metricEnergy B u + 2 * BfgsVerification.dot u (Matrix.mulVec B v) +
          BfgsVerification.metricEnergy B v

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
      Matrix.PosDef H →
        ∀ (x₀ : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
          A.mulVec (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z) = z

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
      Matrix.PosDef H →
        ∀ (x₀ x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
          A.mulVec x = z →
            (BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (x - x₀) =
                BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z - x₀) ↔
              x = BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
      Matrix.PosDef H →
        ∀ (x₀ x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
          A.mulVec x = z →
            BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z - x₀) ≤
              BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (x - x₀)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x))
      (zstar : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
      (∀ (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r), F zstar ≤ F z) →
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          F (A.mulVec (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar)) ≤ F (A.mulVec x)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
      Matrix.PosDef H →
        ∀ (x₀ x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
          A.mulVec x = z →
            BfgsVerification.dot (x - BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z)
                (Matrix.mulVec H⁻¹ (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z - x₀)) =
              0

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
      Matrix.PosDef H →
        ∀ (x₀ x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
          A.mulVec x = z →
            BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (x - x₀) =
              BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z - x₀) +
                BfgsVerification.metricEnergy H⁻¹ (x - BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A H x₀ z)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (g : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g).comp (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.matrixCLM A) =
    BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional (A.transpose.mulVec g)
∀ {n : ℕ}, Function.Injective BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ),
  A * J = 1 →
    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => F (A.mulVec z)) (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        A.transpose.mulVec (J.transpose.mulVec g) = g

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n)
  (g : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) (A.mulVec x) →
    HasFDerivAt (fun z => F (A.mulVec z)) (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional (A.transpose.mulVec g)) x

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (J : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ),
  A * J = 1 →
    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => F (A.mulVec z)) (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional (J.transpose.mulVec g)) (A.mulVec x)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ),
      (BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) → ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F

∀ {n r p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (D : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin n) ℝ) (H : BfgsVerification.Mat n)
  (s : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (y : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  D * H * A.transpose = 0 →
    D.mulVec s = 0 → D * BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s (A.transpose.mulVec y) * A.transpose = 0

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (H : BfgsVerification.Mat n) (s : BfgsVerification.Vec n)
  (y : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS H s (A.transpose.mulVec y)) =
    BfgsVerification.inverseBFGS (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A H) (A.mulVec s) y

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
  Matrix.PosDef H →
    H⁻¹ * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.lift A H = A.transpose * (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A H)⁻¹

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n},
      Matrix.PosDef H →
        BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.lift A H * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A H = H * A.transpose

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.matrixCLM A) x = A.mulVec x

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (R : BfgsVerification.FullBFGSRun n) (gbar : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r),
      (∀ (k : ℕ), A.transpose.mulVec (gbar k) = R.g k) →
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          R.H k * A.transpose =
            BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.lift A (R.H 0) * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H k)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (R : BfgsVerification.FullBFGSRun n) (gbar : ℕ → BfgsVerification.Vec r) (N : ℕ),
      (∀ k ≤ N, A.transpose.mulVec (gbar k) = R.g k) →
        ∀ k ≤ N,
          R.H k * A.transpose =
            BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.lift A (R.H 0) * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H k)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ {H : BfgsVerification.Mat n}, Matrix.PosDef H → A * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.lift A H = 1

∀ {n r p : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (a : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : BfgsVerification.Vec p),
  A * BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter a b = BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (A.mulVec a) b

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A → A * BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.rightInverse A = 1

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A →
    ∀ (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (zstar : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
      (∀ (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r), F zstar ≤ F z) →
        (∀ (z : BfgsVerification.Vec r), F z = F zstar → z = zstar) →
          ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
            (∀ (y : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F (A.mulVec x) ≤ F (A.mulVec y)) ↔ A.mulVec x = zstar

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).H k = BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.compress A (R.H k)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).α k = R.α k

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).curvature k = R.curvature k

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).d k = R.d k

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).displacement k = A.mulVec (R.displacement k)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  R.x k =
    BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0)
      ((BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).x k)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x))
  (zstar : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  Filter.Tendsto (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).x Filter.atTop (nhds zstar) →
    Filter.Tendsto R.x Filter.atTop (nhds (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar)) ∧
      A.mulVec (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar) = zstar ∧
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          A.mulVec x = zstar →
            BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (R.H 0)⁻¹
                  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar - R.x 0) ≤
                BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (R.H 0)⁻¹ (x - R.x 0) ∧
              (BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (R.H 0)⁻¹ (x - R.x 0) =
                  BfgsVerification.metricEnergy (R.H 0)⁻¹
                    (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar - R.x 0) ↔
                x = BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.fiberPoint A (R.H 0) (R.x 0) zstar)

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  (BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).q k = R.q k

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)
  (F : BfgsVerification.Vec r → ℝ) (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n fun x => F (A.mulVec x)) (k : ℕ),
  F ((BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.projectRun A hA F R).x k) = F (A.mulVec (R.x k))

∀ {n r : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : BfgsVerification.AffineProjection.FullRowRank A)

    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g
        (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) +
      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x go gm gi : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ t →
        t ≤ 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ C →
            HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional go)
                (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) →
              HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional gm) x →
                HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional gi)
                    (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) →
                  (0 <
                        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature
                          (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x go gm →
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star x go gm ^ 2 ≤
                        C *
                          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature
                            (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x go gm) →
                    (0 <
                          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                            (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) gm gi →
                        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star
                              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) gm gi ^
                            2 ≤
                          C *
                            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) gm gi) →
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.centralDifference F star x t ≤ 5 * C * t ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ),
          F star < b →
            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasNestedCentralBounds F star b

∀ {n : ℕ} (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  Continuous fun x => BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t

∀ {n : ℕ} (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  Continuous fun x => BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
      t ≠ 1 →
        Dense
          {x | DifferentiableAt ℝ F x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)}

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
      0 ≤ t →
        t < 1 →
          Dense
            {x |
              DifferentiableAt ℝ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) ∧
                DifferentiableAt ℝ F x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)}

∀ {n : ℕ} (x y z : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.dot x (y - z) = BfgsVerification.dot x y - BfgsVerification.dot x z

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : ℝ),
      F star < b →
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          F x ≤ b →
            ∀ {O D : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
              IsOpen O →
                x ∈ O →
                  Dense D → ∃ u, Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds x) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ), F (u j) ≤ b ∧ u j ∈ O ∧ u j ∈ D

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (b : ℝ),
      F star < b →
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          F x ≤ b →
            ∀ {O : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
              IsOpen O →
                x ∈ O →
                  ∀ {t : ℝ},
                    t ≠ 1 →
                      ∃ u,
                        Filter.Tendsto u Filter.atTop (nhds x) ∧
                          ∀ (j : ℕ),
                            u j ∈ interior {w | F w ≤ b} ∧
                              u j ∈ O ∧
                                DifferentiableAt ℝ F (u j) ∧
                                  DifferentiableAt ℝ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star (u j) t)
∀ {N D T C Tmax : ℝ}, 0 ≤ D → D ≤ T → T ≤ Tmax → N ^ 2 ≤ C * T → (N - D) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * C + 2 * Tmax) * T

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t = (1 - t) • x + t • star

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t = (AffineMap.homothety star (1 - t)) x

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
  0 ≤ t →
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t)
        (t / (1 + t)) =
      x

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) =
    F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) - F x + t * BfgsVerification.dot g (x - star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g
            (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) ≤
          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.centralDifference F star x t

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ t →
        t ≤ 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ C →
            HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
              HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional h)
                  (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) →
                (0 <
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                        (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g h →
                    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star
                          (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g h ^
                        2 ≤
                      C *
                        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x
                          (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g h) →
                  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g
                      (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) ≤
                    4 * C * t ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ),
          F star < b →
            IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} →
              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInwardTaylorBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star ↔
                BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInterceptBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (b b' : ℝ),
          b' < b →
            IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasNestedCentralBounds F star b →
                BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInwardTaylorBounds F {x | F x ≤ b'} star

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ),
          F star < b →
            IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star →
                BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInwardTaylorBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        ∀ (G R η : ℝ),
          0 < G →
            0 < R →
              BfgsVerification.sqNorm g ≤ G ^ 2 →
                BfgsVerification.sqNorm (x - star) ≤ R ^ 2 →
                  F star + η ≤ F x →
                    ∀ {t : ℝ},
                      0 ≤ t →
                        t ≤ η / (4 * G * R) →
                          F star + 3 * η / 4 ≤ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        ∀ (M t : ℝ),
          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F z h
                (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star z t) ≤
              M / 2 * t ^ 2 →
            t * BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star z g h ≤
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g z + M / 2 * t ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g h =
      t * BfgsVerification.dot (g - h) (x - star) ∧
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) g
        h =
      -(1 - t) * BfgsVerification.dot (g - h) (x - star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
          0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) ≤ F x

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        ∀ (G R : ℝ),
          0 ≤ G →
            0 ≤ R →
              BfgsVerification.sqNorm g ≤ G ^ 2 →
                BfgsVerification.sqNorm (x - star) ≤ R ^ 2 →
                  ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → F x - t * (G * R) ≤ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ((∃ b,
            F star < b ∧
              IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} ∧ BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star) ↔
          ∃ b,
            F star < b ∧ IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} ∧ BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasNestedCentralBounds F star b)

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (star x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.optimizerIntercept F star x g =
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g star

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t = (AffineMap.homothety star (1 + t)) x

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t C : ℝ),
      0 ≤ t →
        0 ≤ C →
          HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
            HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional h)
                (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) →
              (0 <
                    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature
                      (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x h g →
                  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star x h g ^ 2 ≤
                    C *
                      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature
                        (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x h g) →
                BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g
                    (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) ≤
                  C * t ^ 2

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) x h g =
      t * BfgsVerification.dot (h - g) (x - star) ∧
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star x h g = -BfgsVerification.dot (h - g) (x - star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
          0 ≤ t → F x ≤ F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {t : ℝ},
      0 ≤ t →
        t ≤ 1 →
          F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x t) ≤
            (1 - t) * F x + t * F (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.outwardPoint star x 1)

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (star x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star z g h =
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g z +
        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.optimizerIntercept F star z h -
      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.optimizerIntercept F star x g

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star x h g =
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x z g h -
      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.radialNumerator star z g h
∀ {N D T C Tmax : ℝ}, 0 ≤ D → D ≤ T → T ≤ Tmax → (N - D) ^ 2 ≤ C * T → N ^ 2 ≤ (2 * C + 2 * Tmax) * T

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ {K : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
      IsCompact K →
        ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F K star ↔
            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInterceptBounds F K star

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (b : ℝ),
          F star < b →
            IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} →
              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star ↔
                BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInwardTaylorBounds F {x | F x ≤ b} star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
      (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
        ∀ (b b' : ℝ),
          b' < b →
            IsCompact {x | F x ≤ b} →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasNestedCentralBounds F star b →
                BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F {x | F x ≤ b'} star

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ {K : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
      IsCompact K →
        ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasInwardTaylorBounds F K star →
            BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.HasRadialSecantBounds F K star

∀ {n : ℕ} (F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ) (x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x z g h =
    BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g z +
      BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F z h x

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (G R : ℝ),
  0 ≤ G →
    0 ≤ R →
      BfgsVerification.sqNorm g ≤ G ^ 2 →
        BfgsVerification.sqNorm h ≤ G ^ 2 →
          BfgsVerification.sqNorm (x - star) ≤ R ^ 2 →
            BfgsVerification.sqNorm (z - star) ≤ R ^ 2 →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x z g h ≤ 4 * G * R

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ {x z g h : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional h) z →
        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g z ≤
          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.secantCurvature x z g h

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ {x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
      HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
        ∀ (z : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g z

∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} {Γ : ι → BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (Γ j)) →
    (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ Γ j x) →
      ∀ (p : ι → ℝ) (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {U : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
        IsOpen U →
          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + BfgsVerification.RadialPower.sumObjective Γ p star x) →
            ∀ {x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
              x ∈ U →
                HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
                  DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x →
                    BfgsVerification.dot g (x - star) =
                      (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (x - star) + ∑ j, p j * BfgsVerification.RadialPower.powered (Γ j) (p j) (x - star)

∀ {n m : ℕ} {γ : BfgsVerification.Vec m → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ γ → ∀ (A : BfgsVerification.Vec n →ₗ[ℝ] BfgsVerification.Vec m), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (γ ∘ ⇑A)

∀ {n m : ℕ} {γ : BfgsVerification.Vec m → ℝ},
  BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne γ →
    ∀ (A : BfgsVerification.Vec n →ₗ[ℝ] BfgsVerification.Vec m), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (γ ∘ ⇑A)

∀ {n : ℕ} {γ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ γ →
    BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne γ →
      ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
        HasFDerivAt (fun w => γ (w - star)) (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
          ∀ {t : ℝ},
            t ≤ 1 →
              BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError (fun w => γ (w - star)) x g
                  (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) =
                0

∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} {Γ : ι → BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (Γ j)) →
    (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), 0 ≤ Γ j x) →
      ∀ (p : ι → ℝ) (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n) {U : Set (BfgsVerification.Vec n)},
        IsOpen U →
          (∀ x ∈ U, F x = ψ x + BfgsVerification.RadialPower.sumObjective Γ p star x) →
            ∀ {x g : BfgsVerification.Vec n},
              x ∈ U →
                HasFDerivAt F (BfgsVerification.gradientFunctional g) x →
                  DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x →
                    ∀ {t : ℝ},
                      t ≤ 1 →
                        BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t ∈ U →
                          BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.supportingError F x g
                              (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) =
                            ψ (BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t) - ψ x +
                                t * (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (x - star) +
                              ∑ j,
                                ((1 - t) ^ p j - 1 + p j * t) *
                                  BfgsVerification.RadialPower.powered (Γ j) (p j) (x - star)

∀ {n : ℕ} (star x : BfgsVerification.Vec n) (t : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.RadialCertificate.inwardPoint star x t - star = (1 - t) • (x - star)

∀ {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {m : ι → ℕ} {F ψ : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ},
  ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
    ∀ (γ : (j : ι) → BfgsVerification.Vec (m j) → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : ι), ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (γ j)) →
        (∀ (j : ι), BfgsVerification.Homogeneous.PositiveDegreeOne (γ j)) →
          (∀ (j : ι) (x : BfgsVerification.Vec (m j)), 0 ≤ γ j x) →
            ∀ (A : (j : ι) → BfgsVerification.Vec n →ₗ[ℝ] BfgsVerification.Vec (m j)) (p : ι → ℝ),
              (∀ (j : ι), 1 ≤ p j) →
                ∀ (star : BfgsVerification.Vec n),
                  (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F star ≤ F x) →
                    (∀ (x : BfgsVerification.Vec n), F x = F star → x = star) →
